verdict.rationale: Skills are individual folders/SKILL.md files that can be added, invoked, or disabled one at a time (e.g. /skill-name invocation, disableBundledSkills to strip bundled ones, plugin install of individual skill packages like document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills rather than the whole repo), showing developers can selectively install/enable specific skills rather than an entire bundle. missing for 10: no explicit hands-on/independent confirmation of selectively installing a subset from a multi-skill marketplace bundle (only whole-bundle disable or whole-plugin install patterns are documented), and no dedicated 'pick individual skills from a collection' UI/CLI flag is shown.
